summary: Advance one bounded research loop to audit practical memory evidence against simple baselines.
body: The manager should inspect up to four primary sources on practical agent-memory systems, focusing exclusively on whether they demonstrate benefits over comparable Markdown, transcript, or full-history baselines. This continues the prior loop while directly addressing its audit gaps: exact queries, per-query outcomes, precise inspected sections, and an explicit stopping rule. The work remains research-only and must not install, execute, implement, or imply reproduced results.
